verdicts.reason: A breaks the main image apart: the shoe floats on the left with no backing, and the cream circle sits empty in the lower right, almost touching the subhead. The logo floats mid-canvas, the text column is jammed to the right, and the lower-left half is dead space. B keeps the headline, subhead and shoe-on-circle together in a sensible top-to-bottom order. Its flaws: the shoe sits off-centre from the circle and is oversized, the logo and badge are scattered across the top on no shared edge or axis, the subhead runs as one long line, and the bottom band is empty.
